about: MUSIC-STUDIO-HOME: rows for make_album, make_song_style, edit_band, edit_album and edit_song_style (bench_row music-studio-tool). label = the one tool expected, or N when none of the five may be called. An object link (maipai://music/band|album|style/<id>) is the reference the Music app's Edit buttons send. Persona names only.
